(SHA-256 1242d440c134198b0f1ae7c497290614f15490b5a827e5f3ef60ebd86a2dde5b, equal to the
round-4 worktree.diff). The live worktree diff against c1dd99f18d matches it apart from the
abbreviated index lines, and it holds the same eight files.

## Fold check

Round-3 finding 1 (`wait_verb_test.go` was not gofmt-clean): **holds.**

  `launch.KindEnv:                        "",`, aligned with `"METASYSTEM_OWNER_LINEAGE":            ownerLineage,` at :1574.
- `gofmt -l` over all eight changed files prints nothing (exit 0).

## New defects in the changed lines

None. The only change since round 3's tree is that one-column whitespace realignment, which
has no behavioural effect.

## Proof of round 4

The proof passed after one flake rerun: `TestPendingWaitFromChildShell` failed in the check and
passed when run alone. I checked that this is not caused by the unit's
`pendingWaitHookEnvironment` edit:
- The failure is the cleanup assertion at `wait_verb_test.go:718`, "pending-wait Git
  machine-config probe missing" (exec.log:950). That assertion reads the Git shim transcript,
  not the hook environment that the unit's `launch.KindEnv: ""` entry changes.
- The same message appears in 22 proof logs under ~/.metasystem/launch. They include other
  goals' runs from 2026-10-03 onward, and this unit's own round-1 base-tree run
  (`20261107t161448-aafbfbec7c-r1-s2-base`), before the unit's change. The flake predates U2a and is
  not this unit's regression.

## Non-gating observations

- The diff still carries test-hygiene edits outside the brief's U2 owner list:
  `wait_verb_test.go` (`launch.KindEnv` blanked in the hook environment) and the two steward
  fixtures (`maintenance.auto false`, `gc.auto 0`). Earlier rounds read them without raising a
  finding, they change no production code, and they are not re-raised here.
- The pre-existing `TestPendingWaitFromChildShell` machine-config flake is worth its own goal or
  a flake-register entry; it is outside this unit.

## Budget

12 of 48 tool calls used. Every checklist item for this follow-up was checked: the fold, the
changed lines, and the round-4 proof's flake attribution. Items 1 and 2 were fully read in earlier
rounds; this round re-read the whole diff and found nothing new.

AGREE
